## Summary of Changes

A concise description of the feature, fix, or optimization introduced by this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (latency, rendering, memory, or battery efficiency)
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX refinement (haptics, layout, typography, animations)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

## Verification & Testing

- [ ] Static analysis passed (`flutter analyze`) with zero errors or warnings
- [ ] Unit and widget test suite passed (`flutter test`)
- [ ] Verified manually on physical device or emulator
- [ ] Registered checkpoint entry in `docs/BUILD_CHECKPOINTS.md` (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style conventions and clean architecture
- [ ] All interactive elements include proper tactile/haptic feedback
- [ ] No regression introduced into offline state persistence
